input: Find bribery and corruption enforcement involving Ericsson, including its deferred prosecution agreement

events.type: Criminal FCPA enforcement; deferred prosecution agreement
events.jurisdiction: United States; Southern District of New York
events.parties: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson; U.S. Department of Justice; U.S. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York
events.amount: USD 520,650,432 criminal penalty, including USD 9,520,000 payable on behalf of Ericsson Egypt Ltd. (as_of: 2019-12-06)
events.summary: Ericsson admitted participating in bribery and accounting-control misconduct involving Djibouti, China, Vietnam, Indonesia and Kuwait, entering a DPA requiring a criminal penalty, independent compliance monitoring and continued cooperation.

events.parties: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson; U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
events.amount: USD 458,380,000 disgorgement plus USD 81,540,000 prejudgment interest (as_of: 2019-12-06)
events.summary: Alongside the criminal DPA, Ericsson agreed to resolve SEC civil proceedings concerning the DPA conduct and additional conduct in Saudi Arabia through an injunction, disgorgement and prejudgment interest.

events.type: DPA breach determination; deficient document and information production
events.parties: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson; U.S. Department of Justice
events.summary: Ericsson disclosed that DOJ had determined it breached the DPA by failing to provide certain documents and factual information and had offered the company an opportunity to explain and remediate the breach.

events.type: DPA breach determination; insufficient disclosure of Iraq investigation
events.jurisdiction: United States; underlying conduct in Iraq
events.parties: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson; U.S. Department of Justice
events.summary: DOJ informed Ericsson that its pre-DPA disclosure concerning the internal Iraq investigation was insufficient and that its failure to make subsequent disclosures after entering the DPA constituted a breach.

events.parties: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson; U.S. Department of Justice; U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
events.summary: Ericsson announced its agreement with DOJ and SEC to extend the independent compliance monitorship until June 2024 while continuing to cooperate with DOJ on resolving the breach notification.

events.type: Criminal FCPA guilty plea following DPA breach
events.jurisdiction: United States; Southern District of New York
events.parties: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson; U.S. Department of Justice; U.S. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York
events.amount: USD 206,728,848 additional criminal penalty, eliminating cooperation credit previously awarded under the DPA (as_of: 2023-03-21)
events.summary: Following its DPA breach, Ericsson pleaded guilty to the original deferred charges and became subject to an additional criminal penalty, probation through June 2024 and extended independent compliance monitoring.

events.type: Post-conviction compliance update; monitorship and plea-agreement term completed
events.parties: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson; U.S. Department of Justice; independent compliance monitor
events.summary: Ericsson reported that its independent compliance monitorship and plea-agreement term concluded after the monitor certified that its anti-corruption compliance program satisfied the applicable requirements and was functioning effectively.

events.type: SEC Iraq investigation; closed without recommended enforcement action
events.jurisdiction: United States; underlying conduct in Iraq
events.parties: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson; U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission staff
events.summary: Ericsson reported that SEC staff concluded the investigation opened in June 2022 into matters described in its internal Iraq investigation report and did not intend to recommend enforcement based on the information then available.

events.type: Ongoing DOJ investigation; latest disclosed status, not commencement date
events.jurisdiction: United States; historical conduct in jurisdictions including Iraq and Syria
events.parties: Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson; U.S. Department of Justice
events.summary: In its report dated October 15, 2026, Ericsson stated that DOJ's investigation into matters discussed in its internal Iraq investigation report and related historical conduct remained ongoing, with uncertain scope, duration and outcome.

excluded_namesakes.name: Ericsson Egypt Ltd.
excluded_namesakes.reason: Related but distinct subsidiary, not the requested Swedish parent; its separate guilty plea is not attributed to the parent, although the subsidiary fine expressly included in the parent's DPA payment obligation is identified above.

excluded_namesakes.name: Ericsson Inc.
excluded_namesakes.reason: Separate U.S.-incorporated operating subsidiary identified in Ericsson's annual report; not interchangeable with Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson.

excluded_namesakes.name: Erickson Inc.
excluded_namesakes.reason: Similarly spelled U.S. aviation and helicopter-support business in Oregon, not the Swedish telecommunications company.

output.assessment: As_of 2026-11-10, the parent's admitted corruption-related misconduct, DPA breaches and subsequent guilty plea support an assessment of elevated historical financial-crime risk; its Swedish headquarters and group-parent identity are documented in the annual report (entity source_url: https://www.ericsson.com/492f5d/assets/local/investors/documents/2025/annual-report-2025-en.pdf; enforcement source_url: https://www.justice.gov/criminal/criminal-fraud/fcpa/cases/telefonaktiebolaget-lm-ericsson). The monitorship and plea-agreement term concluded on June 2, 2024, and SEC staff closed the Iraq inquiry without recommending enforcement on September 26, 2024, while the SEC consent judgment's permanent FCPA injunction remained applicable (source_url: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/717826/000119312524237284/d840682d6k.htm). The latest verified company disclosure, dated October 15, 2026, still describes an ongoing DOJ investigation covering historical conduct including Iraq and Syria, with no conclusive outcome and uncertain scope and duration (source_url: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/717826/000162828026065962/a2026q3forfiling.htm).

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
